correctness.rationale: Manzur–Noor original bounded invertible group satisfies ||T_tau^k||=||T_(k tau)||<=1+2k|tau| in both time directions, hence spectral radii of T_tau and inverse <=1 and all ordinary spectral values have modulus one. On H², ||(T_tau-(n+1)^{i tau})e_n||=sqrt(n)| (n+1)^{i tau}-n^{i tau}|<=|tau|/sqrt(n). For tau !=0, phases tau log(n+1) are dense modulo 2pi because unbounded increasing log has vanishing increments; extracted subsequences of orthonormal monomials yield weakly null singular sequences at every unit-circle lambda, excluding Fredholmness via Atkinson parametrix. tau=0 gives I and essential singleton {1}. Independent code checked finite monomial estimates and phase-gap approximation, not the infinite conclusion.
